ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low-intensity (black) dominant surface. Macro-level ratio shows over 90% low-intensity pixels against sparse high-intensity (white) speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Single contiguous low-intensity dark mass. High-contrast white focal points are distributed as discrete, non-geometric specks across both lobes, with a localized cluster at the distal tip of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with acute convergence; bounding box depth relative to lobe height is approximately 1:5.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the entire trailing edge. Notable large-scale rectangular excision on the inner right lobe. Left lobe shows a series of jagged, sharp-peaked valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the upper trailing margins of both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity white pixels (3-10 pixel diameter) concentrated at the distal tips and along the leading edge boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular indentation (potential traumatic loss of tissue) on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density water droplet splash patterns occluding the transition between the fluke surface and the lower water line.
